title: Very severe cyclone Arnab crosses Andhra coast, weakens into severe cyclonic storm: IMD | LIVE
summary: The landfall process is complete with the weather system moving entirely over land; CM Naidu says no loss of life reported in Andhra

title: Karnataka Council polls: B.S. Yediyurappa urges CM to step down, seek fresh mandate
summary: Among other things, he ridiculed the Congress for doubting the credibility of EVMs, pointing out that ballot papers were used in the Council elections

title: Rajasthan panchayat polls: 13% voter turnout recorded till 10 a.m.
summary: The polling began at 7 a.m. for 352 wards of 22 zila parishads and 2,197 wards of 124 panchayat samitis. In some places, however, it was delayed as electronic voting machines (EVMs) malfunctioned

title: Centre forms high-level panel to probe cheetah cub shooting in M.P.’s Kuno
summary: Madhya Pradesh’s top wildlife officials say that it could be a case of shooting in self-defence after mistaking the animal for a leopard, but have so far not ruled out the possibility of poaching

title: Former Keralam PSC official arrested over alleged irregularities in Planning Board exam
summary: Former deputy secretary P. Satheesh was recently named an accused in the case. He was reportedly in charge of PSC’s examination wing and responsible for evaluation process of the controversial test

title: BJP names Hardeep Singh Puri as candidate for Rajya Sabha bypoll in M.P.
summary: The by-election, to be held on November 12, was necessitated after L. Murugan resigned from the Council of Ministers and his Rajya Sabha seat

title: SCR rolls out GPS tracking devices for 1,800 patrolmen across three divisions
summary: Railway patrolemn check for loose fish bolts, defects in switches and crossings, damaged fittings on girder bridges and open-top culverts, broken or burnt sleepers, damaged plates and tie bars, and other track-related issues

title: Karnataka Council polls: Setback to Congress raises questions over leadership and strategy for 2028 Assembly elections
summary: The BJP-JD(S) alliance, which won all four seats, appears to have recovered from the earlier setbacks caused by cross-voting by MLAs in the Council elections and is likely to intensify its attack on the government
